title: cpgdirection: Predict the Direction of CpG-Gene Expression Associations
description: Assigns a direction to the association between DNA methylation at a CpG site and the expression of a nearby gene, for CpGs with no measured eQTM record. Predictions come from a precomputed table of 3,105,697 CpG-gene pairs covering 761,445 CpGs, assembled from measured eQTMs, summary-data Mendelian randomisation, gradient-boosted models of genomic context fitted separately in blood, nasal epithelium and solid tissue, and a distance prior. Each call returns a direction, a calibrated probability, an evidence tier and an expected accuracy, and abstains where the evidence is insufficient. Predictions estimate direction conditional on the CpG being an eQTM; they do not establish that an effect exists.
